caribbean.headline: Caribbean Winds Rise
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten is experiencing 21 kt winds with 5.1 ft wave heights and a 50% rain probability, while Antigua has 17 kt winds, making for a choppy day in the Eastern Caribbean. I expect these conditions to prevail with the dominant swell direction from the east, affecting maritime activities in both ports.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Winds Rise
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing 25 kt winds with 6.8 ft wave heights and less than 10% rain probability, while Naples has relatively calm conditions with 8 kt winds. I expect the strong winds in Mykonos to be the most impactful weather story in the Mediterranean today, with the Eastern Mediterranean bearing the brunt of the elevated wind and wave conditions.
